Asset type: one production master sheet containing SIX original wearable-hat inventory icons for a Daoist chibi game, true transparent RGBA, requested canvas 1536 x 1024, exactly three columns by two rows of 512 x 512 cells.
Input image 1 is a READ-ONLY historical inventory structure reference: use only each object's basic category, silhouette, opening, protrusions and row-major association, NEVER its old pixels, logo, military star or cultural insignia. Input images 2 and 3 are STYLE references only: match the fine hand-painted Daoist chibi finish, jade and ivory materials, warm gold edging, gentle rounded forms and clear small-scale silhouettes. Do not reproduce their UI or people.
Each cell contains exactly one HAT OBJECT ONLY, without a head, hair, face, body, mannequin, pedestal, card, circle, shadow puddle or background. Slight overhead three-quarter product view. Full wearable openings remain actually transparent. Hand-painted fabric, woven straw, flowers and feathers; clean soft highlights, not plastic 3D, not pixel art.
ROW 1 LEFT, source item19: an original red-and-ivory warm knitted cap, rounded tall crown, one golden fluffy top pompom and TWO dangling side pompoms on short cords, broad ivory cloud-knit pattern and restrained jade bead details. Keep the recognisable earflap-cap silhouette.
ROW 1 MIDDLE, source item21: an original jade-green soft travelling cap, low broad folded crown and short rounded front brim, ivory stitched cloud piping, one oval jade-and-warm-gold cloud clasp. No star, military badge, writing, flag or emblem.
ROW 1 RIGHT, source item22: an original ceremonial CLOUD-FEATHER CROWN, semicircular arch of burnt-orange, ivory and muted dark-teal feathers with a taller central feather, warm-gold and jade headband, clear open lower arch, refined Daoist cloud metalwork. No tribal patterns, wearer or face.
ROW 2 LEFT, source item23: an original broad conical woven straw travelling hat, low wide elliptical brim and distinct cone, warm straw-gold fibres, pale jade cloud ribbon around the brim and a small peach-coloured knot. No face or clothing.

ROW 2 RIGHT, source item36: an original honey-amber bee-inspired hat, rounded hollow warm-amber bowl cap with ivory cloud-banded crown and small brim, TWO curved brown antennae ending in golden round tips, a tiny jade cloud clasp. No insect eyes or face.
Composition constraints: the six objects are separate, centred in their assigned cells, each with at least 36 pixels of completely transparent margin on EVERY cell side; all feather tips, tassels and antenna tips fully inside their own cells. Consistent visual weight. Crisp readable broad forms for later 256px and 32/48/64px inventory diagnostics. Do not add text, numbers, labels, UI borders, logos, QQ/brand shapes, dark outline panels, glow blocks, ground shadows, extra accessories or objects. True transparent background, not a checkerboard drawn into RGB.
